Job Title: Financial Analyst IIStatus: ExemptReports to: Director - FinanceDepartment: Finance Job Code: 4310Pay Range: $70,400.00 - $87,000.00 Annually WHO WE ARE:Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.WHO YOU ARE:You are a detail-oriented and analytical finance professional with strong financial reporting, modeling, and data analysis skills. You excel at translating complex financial data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making, business growth, and profitability. With expertise in financial systems, forecasting, reporting, and process improvement, you partner effectively across the organization to deliver accurate analysis, maintain regulatory compliance, and drive continuous improvement.WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Support strategic financial initiatives to aid in the achievement of multi-year ongoing financial objectives to support the financial position, growth, and profitability of the Credit Union, through effective long-term capital management.
Assist in the routine preparation of financial reports for the Credit Union including, but not limited to, information for management reports analyzing financial performance by channels, markets, and peers.
Analyze the monthly financial statements and reports, and communicate variances and relevant findings in support of the financial plan.
Maintain a thorough understanding of the general ledger accounts, components of the balance sheet, income statement, key ratios, products, and other pertinent financial data.
Using PowerBI and/or Excel, aggregate multiple data sources into a single story to summarize the results of a review into actionable points for Senior Management to support business decision-making.
Assist with requirement gathering using interviews, document analysis, use cases, scenarios, and workflow analysis.
Learn and gain an understanding of lending/deposit rates, policies and procedures impacting responsibilities.
Update procedures in response to changes in operational activities or technological upgrades.
Perform reviews or validations of other Financial Analyst work prior to, or in lieu of, review by Team Leadership.
Ensure compliance with applicable standards, rules, regulations, and systems of internal control.
Conduct ad hoc market research, special studies, reviews, analyses, and all other duties as assigned.
Update and maintain financial models including, but not limited to profitability and pricing models through scenario and breakeven point analyses.
Analyze financial results and synthesize through written reports or dashboards, with clean and concise visual charting.
Prepare or create ad hoc financial models, analyses, spreadsheets, visualizations, and presentations that effectively present data and analytical findings for management as reference for strategic decisions, committee review, and other information requests.
Continue to expand on an understanding of lending/deposit rates, policies and procedures impacting responsibilities.
Perform reviews or validations of Financial Analyst I work prior to, or in lieu of, review by Team Leadership.
Maintain a thorough understanding of state and federal laws and regulations related to credit union compliance including bank secrecy and anti-money laundering laws appropriate to the position.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Specializations in this position may include one or more of the following: * General Ledger Accounting * Financial Reporting * Lending (Real Estate Secured/Personal Loan/Vehicle Secured/Credit Cards) * Marketing * Business Banking * Treasury functions * Pricing (Loans and Deposits) * Compliance Reporting * Loan Portfolio Analysis * Membership Analysis

QUALIFICIATIONS AND PREFERENCES:

Bachelor’s Degree in area of specialty (Accounting, Mathematics, Business Administration, Information Technology or similarly quantitative/analytical degrees). Equivalent work experience with required knowledge/skills may be substituted for other degree types required
1+ years of progressive finance or relevant accounting experience required
1+ years of Analytical Experience required

WHY JOIN US:Golden 1 Credit Union provides its employees a market-competitive and internally equitable total rewards compensation package through a variety of programs. These programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain employees that drive and support the achievement of Our Mission, Vision, and Strategic Goals. The Credit Union is committed a total rewards philosophy built on; a comprehensive compensation package, well-being and work-life balance, career development and growth, rewards and recognition, and a commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in fostering a workplace where every employee is recognized, valued, and motivated to contribute their best.Please view the full job description detailing the complete list of duties and expectations for this role by clicking or copying this URL into your browser: https://golden1.jdxpert.com/ShowJob.aspx?EntityID=2&id=2621DISCLAIMER/INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTIONS:The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by team members within this classification. Because the nature of positions and job functions can change over time, this job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all essential functions, duties, responsibilities and qualifications requirements of team members assigned to this job. Job duties may be changed or modified in the Credit Union’s discretion. The Credit Union will keep team members updated on key functions, duties, and requirements of their position by communications from the Credit Union and by updating the job description from time to time. Any team member with questions about the nature of their job duties is encouraged to consult with their supervisor.

TITLE: BUSINESS SYSTEMS ANALYST I     
STATUS: EXEMPT
DEPARTMENT: ENTERPRISE CORES
REPORTS TO: MGR - ENTERPRISE CORES AND APPLICATIONS             
JOB CODE: 11137
PAY SCALE: $76,600.00 - $82,000.00 ANNUALLY        
LOCATION: REMOTE IN CALIFORNIA         
 
 
GENERAL DESCRIPTION:
 
The Business Systems Analyst I role is responsible for engaging with various business units to translate business needs into quality software solutions and assists in the design, development, and implementation of identified solutions following Agile Software development practices. This also includes the operational support for all managed enterprise-wide software solutions. In partnership with the software vendors and business units, the analyst will work to maximize opportunities to use technology to improve products, services, and/or business processes. A solid understanding of the Credit Union’s enterprise-wide software solutions is required. 
TASKS, DUTIES, FUNCTIONS:
 

Oversees all aspects of the Software Development Lifecycle for enterprise-wide software solutions by reviewing, analyzing, and creating detailed documentation of business unit needs, including workflow, program functions, and steps required to implement technical business processes. 
Drives efficient and effective joint business/IT requirements and solution discussions in addition to stakeholder review meetings.
Provide high-quality analytical system solutions for key stakeholders.
Identifies software functional gaps and opportunities of improvement.
Collaborates with product owners to create product backlog by using Agile practices.
Creates user stories with relevant acceptance criteria.
Participates with the implementation of projects as technical subject matter expert from beginning to completion.



Delivery Focus:





80% Project support
20% Department process improvement




Participate in scrum events such as daily scrums, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint retrospective and reviews.
Supports Agile practices and encourages the improvement of service.
Designs, creates, and documents process flows, technical requirements list, specifications, diagrams, scenarios, mockups, and/or models for the development team using Visio, MS Word, Excel, PDF, SharePoint, and other like tools.
Provide Tier 2 application support to uphold day-to-day business line operations, including the resolution of all internal tickets to a timely and successful resolution for all Enterprise-wide managed software solutions.



Operations Focus:





80% Tickets and operational support requests
20% Manage and support software upgrades




Troubleshoots issues, assists in triage, and assesses risk and serves as escalation points for incident management.
Manage administrative functions such as, but not limited to customizations of forms, fields, reports and create saved searches, dashboards, workflows, role-based access management and reporting support.
Effectively work to resolve business line application requests or reported  issues through effective listening skills, positive action, information gathering and/or ticket escalation.
Keep application users regularly informed on progress and resolution for all application issues reported and in alignment with internal service level agreements using clear communication.
Collaborate and coordinate with third-party service providers or other internal technical teams to address software needs-based solutions and production issues with implemented resolutions and consistent follow-up.
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with business line, other internal technical teams, and third-party service providers needed to improve Enterprise-wide software solutions.
Participate in on-call support for critical response to after hour application impairments or major outages as needed.

 
PHYSICAL SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND EXERTION UTILIZED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THESE TASKS:
 

Strong oral and written communication skills required to interact or complete technical analysis with Credit Union staff, management, or vendor partners.
Strong adaption skills contributing to an environment that promotes and enables change to facilitate improved ways of working.
Understanding of Agile based development practices.
Must possess sufficient manual dexterity to skillfully operate an on-line computer terminal and other standard office equipment, such as financial calculators, personal computer, printer, facsimile machine, and telephone.
Makes sound decisions in the absence of detailed instructions.
Ability to multitask, work under pressure and tight deadlines; may be required to work extended hours to complete tasks or respond to system production issues.
Proven ability to develop, document and maintain operational policies and procedures, including the designing and documenting detailed technical process flows, and the development of operational performance and quality metric standards and reports.

ORGANIZATIONAL CONTACTS & RELATIONSHIPS:
 

INTERNAL: All Credit Union Staff
EXTERNAL: Vendors, suppliers, government agencies, other industry associations and peers at other financial institutions.

QUALIFICATIONS:
 
EDUCATION: Minimum two-year degree in Information Technology, Project Management or Business Administration required, or 2 years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Information Technology, Engineering, Management, or related field preferred with 2+ years of experience. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a 2-year degree. Agile certifications preferred.
 
EXPERIENCE: Four years or more experience in financial or health services, including technical business analysis, product development and process improvement. Experience working in an Agile environment or Azure eco system (DevOps) strongly desired.
 
KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS:
 

Knowledge of commonly used financial industry concepts, practices, and guidelines.
Knowledge of existing Credit Union products, services and overall operational guidelines, especially as it relates to various delivery channels.
Excellent oral communication, presentation and technical writing skills.
Strong research, technical analysis, planning and organizational skills.
Ability to use logical reasoning when interpreting facts.
Experience with medium to large enterprise software systems, as well as the ability to learn new systems quickly.
Ability to analyze and document complex technical business processes. 
Ability to make observations, examinations, evaluations and recommendations.
Ability to execute projects and direct team members to implement system upgrades and enhancements.
Strong PC skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
 

Carry and respond to a cell phone 7 days a week. May need to diagnose problems from home, occasionally may need to travel to site to correct problem either by car or public conveyance.
Prolonged sitting throughout the workday with occasional mobility required. 
Corrected vision within the normal range.
Hearing within normal range. A device to enhance hearing will be provided if needed.
Ability to lift 20 lbs. as may be required.
Occasional movements throughout the department daily to interact with staff, accomplish tasks, etc.
Occasional travel may be required locally, statewide, and throughout the United States to attend seminars and vendor group meetings. Overnight travel and evening schedules included.
Occasionally required to change work hours or work long hours including working on weekends to accomplish tasks.

LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS: 
None
THIS JOB DESCRIPTION PROVIDES AN OVERVIEW OF THE GENERAL SCOPE AND LEVEL OF WORK EXPECTED TO BE PERFORMED, BUT IT IS NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE LIST OF ALL DUTIES OR RESPONSIBILITIES ASSOCIATED WITH THE POSITION. THE CREDIT UNION RESERVES THE RIGHT TO MODIFY, ADD, OR REMOVE DUTIES AS NEEDED WITHOUT ADVANCE NOTICE. EMPLOYEES MAY BE REQUIRED TO PERFORM ADDITIONAL TASKS AND DUTIES AS DIRECTED BY THEIR SUPERVISOR, PROVIDED SUCH TASKS ARE WITHIN THE EMPLOYEE’S KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES, OR CAN BE PERFORMED WITH REASONABLE TRAINING. NOTHING IN THIS JOB DESCRIPTION ALTERS THE AT-WILL EMPLOYMENT RELATIONSHIP OR LIMITS THE CREDIT UNION’S RIGHT TO ASSIGN OR REASSIGN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES TO THIS POSITION AT ANY TIME.

jobPostings.jobDescription:
TITLE: OPERATIONS SERVICES - BUSINESS ANALYSTSTATUS: EXEMPTREPORTS TO: SUPERVISOR - OPERATION SERVICESDEPARTMENT: OPERATIONS SERVICESJOB CODE: 11851
PAY RANGE: $70,400.00 - $73,000.00 ANNUALLY
 
GENERAL DESCRIPTION:
The Business Analyst, User Acceptance Testing for Service Operations, will support the Director in ensuring the overall quality of systems within Service Operations. This role involves collaborating with various teams to develop and execute UAT strategies, plans, and activities specific to Service Operations. The Business Analyst will also focus on continuous improvement initiatives and act as a liaison between business, project, and technology stakeholders.
TASKS, DUTIES, FUNCTIONS:

Support UAT Strategy Development: Assist in developing and refining the UAT strategy, methodology, and framework for Service Operations.
Test Planning and Execution: Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, and development teams to define UAT scope, objectives, and timelines. Develop and execute test plans, including test case development, test execution, defect tracking, and resolution.
Service Pack Testing: Assist in planning and executing service pack testing for all of Service Operations, ensuring that updates and patches are thoroughly tested before deployment.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for improvement in UAT processes and implement best practices, tools, and techniques.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as a point of contact for UAT-related communications, providing updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, and issues.
Governance and Compliance: Assist in building and maintaining a governance model for UAT activities within Service Operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
Training and Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior UAT team members and other stakeholders on UAT principles and practices. Participate in cross-training initiatives to ensure staff are well-versed in various aspects of UAT and Service Operations.
Tool Utilization: Ensure the proper usage of available testing tools to maximize the effectiveness of UAT efforts.
Project Participation: Participate in projects related to Service Operations products and services, including ACH, Checks, Wires, Treasury Management, Digital Banking, Deposit Account Servicing, and Consumer Loan Processing.
System Analysis: Conduct analysis of system health and performance, identify gaps, recommend solutions, and provide multi-level communications on system-related information.
Vendor Management: Function as a liaison with vendors, business, and IT teams to document issues and follow up until resolution.
Testing Support: Provide testing support for both Quality Assurance (QA) and Business User Acceptance Testing (UAT) phases, including test planning, script documentation, and scheduling of unit, integration, functional, QA, and user acceptance testing.
Research and Analysis: Complete research, analysis, and recommendations on system changes, efficiencies, and suggested services from vendors.
System Troubleshooting: Assist in system troubleshooting calls with vendors in relation to payments systems upgrades, implementations, setting changes, and issues.
Professional Analytics: Provide detailed professional analytics on products and services to Senior Management and project teams as applicable.
RFP Analysis: Assist with RFP cost, benefit analysis, and propose responses to various RFP concerns.
Requirements Translation: Translate business requirements and objectives into system requirements for technical staff.
Technical Documentation: Interpret technical designs and vendor specification documentation.
Program Documentation: Develop and maintain applicable program documents.
Regulatory Compliance: Maintain a thorough understanding of state and federal laws and regulations related to credit union compliance, including bank secrecy and anti-money laundering laws appropriate to the position.
Relationship Management: Develop and maintain working relationships with all levels of management, peers, and subordinates, both internally and externally with peers and vendors, to accomplish credit union strategic goals.
Additional Duties: Perform any other duties or special requests assigned.
Training Support: Assist with training junior staff and other areas as needed.

 
PHYSICAL SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND EXERTION UTILIZED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THESE TASK:

Hand-eye coordination required for reading, posting, and settling numerous complex general ledger accounts and or account related issues.

 

Must possess sufficient manual dexterity to skillfully operate an on-line computer terminal and other standard office equipment including an adding machine, personal computer, facsimile, copy machines and telephone.

 

Effective oral and written communication skills required to train, make general ledger entries, prepare reports, constructively follow up on member inquiries and perform other related tasks.

 

Makes sound decisions in the absence of detailed instructions.

 

Plans and organizes work with little or no assistance and requires minimal supervision.

 
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTACTS & RELATIONSHIPS:

INTERNAL: All levels of staff and leaders across departments, throughout the credit union.
EXTERNAL: Vendors, partners, and consultants.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION: Successful completion of a high school diploma is required. An Associate’s degree is required; additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
EXPERIENCE:  


4+ years of relevant experience in business analysis and user acceptance testing. Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams. Project participation, including management and coordination of projects, is a plus.
Experience in the analysis and development of financial services, including systems, is desired.
Financial institution experience is a plus.
Experience with Golden 1’s key vendors and products such as Fiserv (DataSafe, DNA) is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS: 

Strong understanding of UAT methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

enterprise performance management tools such as OneStream
integrating data from ERP systems such as NetSuite

Exposure to AI tools or large language model (LLM) applications within a business analytics context

About the Opportunity
The Principal SOC Analyst is a senior hands-on technical and operational role within Dayforce Cybersecurity Operations, responsible for advancing the effectiveness, maturity, and scalability of Security Operations. The role provides leadership in operational excellence (BAU), incident handling quality, process alignment, analyst enablement, and continuous improvement across a globally distributed environment.
The successful candidate serves as the principal technical and operational partner to Cybersecurity Security Operations leadership, translating strategic objectives into operational outcomes while driving process maturity, service quality, automation adoption, AI innovation, executive reporting, and continuous improvement across Cybersecurity Operations.
What You'll Get to Do

Cybersecurity Security Operations BAU Leadership and Operational Execution (35%) – Support SOC leaders in the day-to-day technical management of SOC BAU operations by maintaining operational rhythm, monitoring service quality, coordinating priorities, improving handovers and escalations, and ensuring analysts have the clarity, guidance, and process discipline needed to deliver consistent outcomes.
Incident Handling Oversight and Quality Improvement (20%) – Improve the quality, consistency, and timeliness of security incident handling by strengthening triage practices, escalation paths, evidence quality, case documentation, containment coordination, post-incident follow-up, and lessons-learned activities without becoming the primary owner of all day-to-day case work.
Process Maturity and Continuous Improvement (20%) – Identify, analyse, and resolve recurring SOC operational issues by improving processes, playbooks, runbooks, quality controls, operating procedures, metrics, and governance practices that increase reliability, reduce friction, and mature the way the SOC operates.
Automation, AI, and Operational Enablement (10%) – Drive practical improvement opportunities by leveraging automation, AI-assisted workflows, analytics, dashboards, and tool optimisation to reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, enhance analyst productivity, and create scalable operational practices across Cybersecurity Security Operations workflows.
Stakeholder and Communication (10%) – Translate operational and technical matters into clear, concise communication for leaders, partners, engineering/application/support teams, incident management, and business stakeholders, including status updates, risk summaries, operational metrics, improvement plans, and decision-support materials.
Analyst Enablement and Knowledge Management (5%) – Promote operational excellence through technical coaching, documentation, knowledge sharing, process improvement, and quality assurance activities that enhance analyst effectiveness and consistency, while partnering with people leaders on development initiatives as needed.

Skills and Experience We Value

Deep hands-on experience in Security Operations. With a proven track record of operating as a senior analyst, technical lead, shift lead, SOC engineer, or deputy to SOC leadership in a complex security operations environment
Strong understanding of SOC BAU, incident handling, and operational execution. Including alert triage, incident escalation, case quality, handovers, response coordination, post-incident follow-up, service quality, and the practical realities of running a high-performing SOC
Proven ability to improve processes and operational maturity. Including the ability to identify recurring pain points, perform root cause analysis, define sustainable improvements, strengthen runbooks and playbooks, and drive measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, and quality
Broad technical knowledge of modern security operations technologies. Practical capability to leverage automation, AI, and data-driven improvement. Including the ability to identify high-value automation opportunities, use analytics and metrics to support decisions, partner with engineering teams on workflow improvements, and apply AI-assisted approaches responsibly to improve operational effectiveness
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. With the ability to translate complex technical and operational topics into clear business language, prepare leadership-ready updates, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
Advanced technical, analytical, and leadership capabilities. Including sound judgement, calm decision-making under pressure, mentoring and coaching ability, strong documentation practices, familiarity with Agile or continuous improvement methods, and relevant industry certifications such as CEH, GASAE, CISSP, GCIH, Security+, CySA+, cloud security certifications, or equivalent experience.

As a Principal Data Analyst, you are a highly analytical, forward-thinking, and proactive problem solver who thrives on turning data into strategic insight. You will play a pivotal role within the Decision Intelligence team, helping to drive data-informed strategies, optimize key business processes, and identify opportunities to integrate artificial intelligence (AI) and automation into analytical workflows. This role offers significant visibility across the organization, engaging with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Your work will directly influence strategic decisions and help foster a stronger data-driven and AI-enabled culture across the enterprise.
What You'll Get to Do

Translate business questions into analytical solutions that go beyond stated needs by proactively surfacing insights that guide executive strategy and operational excellence.
Design, build, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards that visualize performance metrics, automate reporting, and democratize access to insights across teams.
Partner with business leaders across designated departments to define key metrics, interpret performance results, and connect analytics to financial and growth objectives.
Collaborate with the Data Science team to build and maintain predictive and prescriptive models, including regression, clustering, decision trees, customer segmentation, and revenue optimization.
Champion data quality and governance by identifying data gaps, implementing cleansing and validation best practices, and partnering with Engineering teams to strengthen data integrity.
Continuously evaluate AI tools, techniques, and platforms that enhance automation, forecasting, and insight generation across business functions.
Present complex analyses as clear, compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Stay current on emerging analytics technologies, visualization trends, and AI innovations that can drive competitive advantage.

Skills and Experience We Value

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related analytical field; Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, decision science, econometrics, or similar analytical roles, preferably within an enterprise SaaS, technology, consulting, or complex business environment.
Deep expertise in Power BI and SQL, including scalable semantic models, executive dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics.
Strong understanding of data modeling, KPI design, data quality, and governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, identify root causes, quantify business impact, and recommend practical actions.
Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to define success metrics, interpret performance trends, and connect analytics to financial, operational, customer, and growth outcomes.
Proven experience leading complex analytics initiatives from concept through implementation with minimal oversight.
Working knowledge of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics concepts including regression, clustering, classification, forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection, and predictive modeling.
Ability to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve reporting efficiency, forecasting, and business decision support.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to present complex data to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to prioritize analytical initiatives based on business value.
High degree of curiosity, ownership, sound judgment, and attention to detail.
Experience in the Human Capital Management (HCM) industry is preferred.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience driving enterprise-wide analytics strategies and executive decision support.
Expertise applying AI and automation to business intelligence and reporting.
Experience building scalable self-service analytics environments.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership through data-driven insights.
Experience within Human Capital Management or enterprise software environments.

About the Opportunity
As demand for our Dayforce Human Capital Management (HCM) solution continues to grow, we are expanding our German Payroll Support team.
We are looking for a technically minded, analytical, and customer-focused Application Support Analyst with a strong background in German Payroll. In this role, you will join a highly collaborative team supporting some of our largest customers while working closely with Product & Technology to continuously improve the Dayforce Payroll solution.
This role goes beyond traditional application support. You will combine technical analysis, payroll expertise, and customer focus to investigate complex issues, identify product improvements, and proactively help customers maintain compliant payroll processes.
Our team lives our core values every day: Customer Focus, Transparency, Diligence, Optimism, and Agility.
 
What you’ll get to do
As an Application Support Analyst - German Payroll, you will provide technical and functional support for Dayforce Payroll customers and collaborate closely with Payroll Administrators, HR teams, IT departments, Managed Services, Services, Global Support, and Product & Technology.
Your responsibilities will include:

Investigating and resolving complex German Payroll incidents.
Performing root cause analysis using SQL, database queries, and reporting tools.
Supporting customers with payroll-related product functionality and configuration questions.
Identifying, reproducing, documenting, and validating product defects while working closely with Product & Technology to drive permanent resolutions.
Supporting German statutory payroll functionality, including topics such as DEÜV, ELStAM, EEL, A1, Accident Insurance, Garnishments, and Payroll Elections.
Performing technical data analysis to support customers, Managed Services, and Product & Technology.
Developing proactive customer health checks by identifying missing or inconsistent payroll data before it impacts payroll processing.
Building SQL queries, reports, and dashboards to support complex customer investigations.
Working with Power BI and other reporting tools to identify trends, recurring customer issues, and opportunities for product improvements.
Creating and maintaining customer-facing documentation and Knowledge Base articles.
Contributing to continuous improvements of support processes and the overall customer experience.
Sharing knowledge with colleagues and helping to further develop the team's expertise.

 
Skills/Experience We Value:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Solid experience with German Payroll and German payroll legislation.
Strong understanding of German statutory payroll processes (e.g., DEÜV, ELStAM, EEL, AAG/U1/U2, A1, Accident Insurance).
Fluent written and spoken German and English.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in technical application support, payroll support, or software support.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a passion for solving complex technical and functional problems.
Experience working with SQL and relational databases for troubleshooting and data analysis.
Ability to analyse business processes across multiple systems.
Excellent communication, organizational, and customer service skills.
Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness to work flexible hours and participate in an on-call rotation when required.

What would make you really stand out:

Experience supporting Dayforce Payroll or another HCM/Payroll application.
Experience performing SQL-based data analysis and root cause investigations.
Experience with Power BI, reporting, or data visualization tools.
Experience developing or maintaining SQL queries, reports, or analytical solutions.
Experience with APIs or other integration technologies.
Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and Windows Server technologies.
Experience with scripting or automation technologies (e.g., PowerShell).
Experience creating customer-facing technical documentation or Knowledge Base articles.
Experience working directly with Development or Product teams to reproduce, analyse, and validate software defects.
Additional language skills (e.g., French or Spanish) are considered an asset.

 
Why Join Us?

Work remotely from anywhere in Germany.
Become part of a growing team specializing in German Payroll.
Solve technically challenging problems with direct customer impact.
Work closely with Product & Technology to influence and improve one of the market-leading HCM platforms.
Combine payroll expertise with SQL, analytics, and technical problem-solving.
Develop deep expertise in German Payroll, data analysis, Power BI, and enterprise application support.
Work in a collaborative environment where innovation, proactive thinking, and continuous learning are encouraged.
Enjoy excellent opportunities for professional growth in an innovative, customer-focused organization.

 
Language Requirements: Fluent written and spoken German and English are required.
